# TPC-DS-OBT Q15

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  bill_addr_ca_zip,
  SUM(sales_price)
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    bill_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk
    AND bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk
    AND (
      SUBSTRING(bill_addr_ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) IN ('85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', '81792')
      OR bill_addr_ca_state IN ('CA', 'WA', 'GA')
      OR sales_price > 500
    )
    AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
    AND sold_date_d_qoy = 1
    AND sold_date_d_year = 1998
  )
  AND channel = 'catalog'
GROUP BY
  bill_addr_ca_zip
ORDER BY
  bill_addr_ca_zip
LIMIT 100
```
